entities.name: Roreca's Tale
entities.description: Short story about the fight between planeswalkers Worzel and Thomil on Ergamon, told by Roreca; first published in 1994.

entities.name: Worzel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose wards alert her to Thomil; she fights him with summoned creatures and spells.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: Planeswalker and Worzel's old enemy who flees Ergamon after his Lord of the Pit turns on him.

entities.name: Roreca
entities.description: Worzel's familiar, who tells the tale.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: Demon summoned by Thomil that attacks him instead.

entities.name: Ergamon
entities.description: Plane where the fight takes place.

events.summary: Worzel's wards alert her to the presence of her old enemy Thomil while traveling Ergamon, and they fight with summoned creatures and spells.
events.quote: Worzel's wards alert her to the presence of Thomil, an old enemy.

events.summary: Thomil summons a Lord of the Pit, which Worzel holds off until it attacks Thomil; he flees the plane.
events.quote: resulting in the demon attacking Thomil instead

relations.quote: the presence of Thomil, an old enemy
as told by Worzel's familiar Roreca
